newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Boat capsizes killing 11 in Vietnam.
newsitem.headline: Boat capsizes killing 11 in Vietnam.

text.p: Eleven people, including several teenagers, drowned when a boat overturned in a lake in central Vietnam, a provincial official said on Wednesday.
Doan Dinh Gia, of the Ha Tinh People's Committee, said passengers panicked when the boat ran into problems close to a dam flood gate last week.
The vessel capsized, spilling all 42 passengers into the water about 20 metres (65 feet) from the edge.
Gia said several teenagers and women were among the dead.
The tragedy, some 300 km (190 miles) south of Hanoi, occurred just ahead of the Tet lunar new year festival.
